review_brief:
# Review return: two native parametric builds

## 9df4a42fced1

Built the exact-default `canonical` / `center_chain` family. The alternative is
sequential rather than cosmetic: the canonical frame reduction creates a sparse,
input-derived center-label grid, and only then does the second stage choose path
endpoints, ordering, bends, and retained colors from that grid. Geometry varies
across seeds, the two-demo minimum rejects the tested vertical-first,
reverse-order, and original-seed-position rivals, and a protected skip-A witness
changes the selected query result.

## fad48869c581

Repaired the base generator's control and construction gaps, then built the
exact-default `canonical` / `square_halo` family. The alternative first completes
L triominoes into solid 2×2 squares and then expands only those derived squares.
The bank includes isolated distractors, boundary contact, varied missing corners,
and two distributed 30×30 cases. A target-local compatibility launcher repairs a
legacy singleton-test-record shape only in memory so the shared authoring
preflight can run without weakening raw-source drift checks.

Both targets have current source inventories, protected-Racket authoring
preflights, causal witness/replay receipts, staged tests, adversarial bounded
audits, and 16 verified single-query public projections with first-turn privacy
checks. The return is reviewer-ready source and evidence only. It does not claim
owner integration, native acceptance, variant approval, or training admission.

previous_catalog_record.summary: 0-bg grid (h~6-9, w~6-9) with 2-4 ISOLATED 2×2 BLOCKS placed at non-touching positions (3-cell pairwise padding guard). Each block: pick a non-0 color from {1..9}; pick one of the 4 CORNERS as the MISSING corner; PAINT the other 3 corners with the chosen color. The fourth corner stays bg-0. Each block thus presents an L-triomino with one empty corner. Blocks are widely separated to avoid accidental completions. Rule (COMPLETE EACH 2×2 BLOCK BY FILLING ITS MISSING CORNER WITH THE BLOCK'S COLOR): for EACH 2×2 WINDOW that has EXACTLY 3 cells of ONE non-0 color C and the FOURTH cell = bg-0: RECOLOR the missing-corner 0 cell to C. The other cells stay. Non-active 2×2 windows (with different color counts or all bg) are unchanged. Net: each L-triomino is closed into a solid 2×2 monochrome square.

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-preserving grid after canonical completion: each intended L is now a solid color-matched 2x2 square, while isolated nonzero distractors remain unchanged.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Execute the exact canonical snapshot rule, filling the unique background corner of every monochrome L triomino to create solid 2x2 squares.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Read only the completed snapshot, find each solid nonzero 2x2 square, and fill its one-cell clipped halo with that square color without overwriting existing nonzero cells.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Stage B selects its locations and colors from solid 2x2 squares. The original input contains only three-cell Ls and no solid squares; Stage A creates every trigger that Stage B expands.
